name: DEATH GUARD: MORTARION, DAEMON PRIMARCH OF NURGLE
description: Mortarion is the Lord of the Death Guard – to stand in his presence is lethal, such is the infectious aura surrounding him. Wielding his gigantic scythe, Silence, he cuts apart entire enemy squads in seconds. With furious blasts of Lantern, his devastating sidearm, he disintegrates heavy infantry and armour alike, leaving their glowing ashes swirling in his wake.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds Mortarion, a hulking Daemon Primarch to lead your Death Guard armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. This hulking miniature is covered in detail, from oozing vents, to flies, and filthy semi-organic hoses, making him an ideal centrepiece for your collection, and a challenge for your painting skills. On the battlefield, he is incredibly hard to kill, absorbing firepower that would decimate the rest of your army, and he can take on anything the galaxy throws at him with his arcane pistol, Lantern, and the deadly, plague-ridden scythe, Silence. The weapons can be swapped from hand to the other, offering a degree of customisation.</br></br>This kit comprises 78 plastic components, and 1x Citadel 100mm Round Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
